items.name: Elephant
items.ask: Mega quiz time! Who is this shadow?
items.hint: It has big floppy ears and a long, long trunk!

items.name: Ladybug
items.hint: It is little and red with black spots!

items.name: Rocket
items.hint: Three, two, one... it zooms up to space!

items.name: Dolphin
items.hint: It lives in the sea and loves to jump and splash!

items.name: Coat
items.hint: We wear it to stay warm on cold, snowy days!

items.name: Camel
items.ask: Last one! Who is this shadow?
items.hint: It has humps on its back and walks in the hot desert!

seo.title: Mega Shadow Quiz! 🐘🚀 Guess the Shadow for Kids | Guessing Game for Kids | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Can your little one guess all 6 shadows in Kiddo's Mega Shadow Quiz? 🤔 Look at the shadow, listen to the clue, and shout the answer!

A fun guessing game for kids that mixes animals, bugs, sea animals, vehicles and clothes. Children practise 6 words:
🐘 Elephant
🐞 Ladybug
🚀 Rocket
🐬 Dolphin
🧥 Coat
🐫 Camel

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more Guess with Kiddo games: animals, vehicles, sports, letters and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
